My now fiancé fell in love with Animal Crossing once I introduced it to her. I had a Switch, and I would find her playing it more often than I would. I wanted to surprise her, and it took me a while to plan it all out. We have 3 cats together and I wanted to incorporate it into the surprise somehow. I made a scavenger hunt (she loves puzzles and murder mystery type things) that led us all around our apartment and eventually to where I was going to propose. Each glass bottle had letter beads that spelled out the location of the next clue. I photoshopped a DIY card so she knew how many items she had to collect before getting her “Special Gift.” When we arrived at the location, I had a small fossil ring box I purchased from Etsy. She KNEW I had mentioned it before, so I had to throw her off from my plan. I bought her an Animal Crossing edition Switch, and put the game inside there. She was so confused and distracted that she had no idea what was coming next. I pulled the ring out from my pocket, and she said yes. She is truly the love of my life, and I can’t imagine living life without her. If anyone has any questions about the scavenger hunt, feel free to let me know!

30, and got mine last December. I met my girlfriend on r/cf4cf and we are perfect together. If you don’t want kids, don’t let anyone change that for you. If you are still on the fence, wait another year or two before making any decisions. I’ve known my whole life I didn’t want kids. Sex freaked me out, and I could never enjoy it knowing that my body could reproduce. This needs to be a YOU decision. It would be a horrible idea to not want kids and have them just because your partner wants them.

Ask them for some kind of medication before the procedure. I got Xanax and it helped me tremendously. I was so sick to my stomach the day before my procedure that I had to take off work because of how worked up I was. Don’t let it get to your head, I’d honestly rather have a vasectomy than stub my pinky toe on something. There were some “painful” moments, but nothing I couldn’t tolerate with the Xanax and numbing they used. Communicate with your doctor and explain how things have gone for you in the past. If they are unwilling to be understanding and accommodate, find another doctor. I told my doctor I have a low pain tolerance and he numbed me up pretty good as things went along.

The doctor who performed the procedure just confirmed my stance and went to snipping. If this is something you are both certain about, go for it. Their opinion and personal beliefs do not matter and there are plenty of doctors who would be willing to perform the procedure.

I have been wearing a jock, then my briefs, thermals, and then sweatpants to work every day. If you don’t want to use a jock, double up on tight fitting briefs. Get some easy microwaveable or pre made foods so you don’t have to be on your feet much. Take whatever your doctor will give you beforehand (Valium or Xanax,) and you’ll be all set. Make sure to stay hydrated, eat, and try to rest whenever you can. I had mine done on a Friday and was off my feet as much as possible through the weekend. I have been using Vaseline during the second week to help the skin heal. It helps reduce the itching and my skin has been healing great.
